title: Point probabilities of the correlated sign law
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $X,Y$ be signs. The probability of the pair $(X,Y)$ under the correlated sign law is the product of the uniform probability of $X$ and the conditional noise probability of obtaining $Y$ from $X$.
